tob-0038-d3: Church Committee Book III — the Supplementary Detailed Staff Report on Foreign and Military Intelligence — gives the deep documentation behind Book I. Its staff reports detail covert operations case by case. The volume is the scholar’s companion to the main report.
tob-0039-d3: This microfilm roll carries a piece of the official record of the Doctors’ Trial — the Nuremberg case against physicians for Nazi medical cruelty. Witnesses, the accused, and counsel all speak here. The record anchors the story of the Nuremberg Code.
